name: Basic Visitor Counter
author: Trickyenough

sections.description:
Basic Visitor Counter is a minimalistic and lightweight WordPress plugin designed to track the number of visitors on your website effortlessly. Whether you need a simple hit counter or basic analytics, this plugin provides an easy-to-use solution without slowing down your site.

Features:

  • Real-time Visitor Tracking – Displays the total number of visitors on your site.
  • Daily & All-time Stats – Keep track of daily visits and lifetime stats.
  • Simple & Lightweight – No unnecessary bloat, just clean and efficient tracking.
  • Customizable Display – Show visitor counts anywhere using a widget or shortcode.
  • No External Dependencies – Runs entirely on your WordPress site, ensuring privacy.
  • Compatible with All Themes – Works seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

How to Use:

Install and activate the Basic Visitor Counter plugin.

Go to the settings page to configure your preferences.
Use the provided widget or [basivicoun_track_visitor] to display visitor counts anywhere on your site.

Why Choose Basic Visitor Counter?

This plugin is perfect for website owners who need a simple, effective way to track visitors without complex analytics tools. No tracking scripts, no cookies—just a straightforward visitor counter.

Get started today and keep track of your site’s visitors effortlessly!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins in the Admin menu
  2. Click on the button Add new
  3. Search for Basic Visitor Counter and click ‘Install Now’ or click on the upload link to upload basic-visitor-counter.zip
  4. Click on Activate plugin
